domain: Level-test fitness audit and replacement planning for academy-assessment item bank

broadcast.goal: Judge every generated-bank item for GLEAS level-test fitness and emit a deterministic replace_plan with per-slot replacement specs.
constraints: Replacement preserves domain, level, and dimension/questionType slot.
Reading passages are never rewritten; items sit on preset text only.
New irtSource must remain ai_prior until empirical calibration.
Factual lane conflicts are never averaged; escalate to scalar tail.
Every defect cites item_id, code, span, and lane_id provenance.
SEED_DEMO items quarantine; they are not rewritten into production stems.
acceptance_tests: Every item_id in the bank appears in replace_plan with one disposition.
Every replace entry has replacement_spec with domain, level, targetTheta.
Conflicts appear only under exceptions, not as blended dispositions.
workspace/level-test/FITNESS_REPORT.md and replace_plan.json exist after a successful run.

role: Score IRT a/b/c alignment to targetTheta and MCQ guessing band.
Check domain construct, stem completeness, passage dependency, slot type.
Audit option sets for uniqueness, parallelism, and valid answer index.
Flag seed/demo items, generic synonym patterns, and level-lexis heuristics.

schema_valid.description: Lane output matches lane_output_schema with no missing or extra keys.

constraint_satisfied.description: disposition_vote consistent with codes severity (error cannot vote keep).

provenance_present.description: lane_id present and evidence non-empty when severity is not pass.

code_from_catalog.description: Every code is listed in references/level-test-codes.md catalog (or PASS).

scalar_tail.budget_note: Pass 1 re-runs failed lanes; pass 2 records human exceptions. Generation of replacements is a separate Stage V2 run, not unbounded tail.

concurrency.note: Default runner is sequential Python. Set actual_subagents only with explicit multi-agent authorization.
